title: A2A Governance Evaluation
description: Payload format for the policy-decision-point contract exchanged with a2a-governance. a2a-governance does not execute changes itself; it answers 'is this action permitted, and why?' and records every decision to an append-only audit trail. NOTE: the specific policy rule catalog (which actions map to which effect) is intentionally not part of this public contract and is defined privately per deployment.

trace_id.description: Unique identifier correlating this evaluation across the init/observe/act/report lifecycle. Auto-generated (32-char hex, OpenTelemetry-compatible) by the calling client if omitted -- never sent empty, so audit entries stay correlatable.

action.description: Dot-separated action identifier evaluated against the (private) policy catalog, e.g. 'netconf.edit_config.vlan' or 'eapi.show.interfaces'.

requesting_agent.description: Name of the agent requesting evaluation (e.g. junos_netconf_write_a2a_server).

context.description: Optional supplementary detail about the action being evaluated, e.g. a containment.json or vendor-core.json payload, for audit purposes.

effect.description: Null until evaluated. PERMIT: execution proceeds silently. REVIEW: non-blocking -- execution proceeds (a human is expected to have already approved the change via the calling agent's own diff/history UI), but the reason is written to the audit trail and surfaced to the caller. DENY: the only blocking effect -- execution must stop regardless of any human intent expressed elsewhere. Governance intentionally does not run a second, separate approval queue for REVIEW.

reason.description: Human-readable explanation for the effect, drawn from the matched policy rule (or the safe-default heuristic when no rule matches).

audit_event_id.description: Unique identifier of the resulting entry in the append-only audit trail.
